verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU, NPU and memory subsystem). Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is an identity and access-management capability of a software or SaaS service, not something a chip could ship, so this is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself issuing credentials; the AI Hub developer tooling is model-optimization software and documents no credential scoping.
